name: drqv2-residual-options-pilot-v1

environment.observation: official four-frame float32 grayscale CHW 84x84 in [0,1]
environment.reward: raw CarEnvironment reward; no shaping, normalization, or collision penalty
environment.action: native symmetric [-1,1]^3; ActionAdapter maps to official [steer,gas,brake] exactly once

base_driver.use: frozen inference-only driver; inherited training cost is not counted as a matched new training comparison

training.checkpoint: save after the fixed decision budget; discard an incomplete final option transition

development_screen.role: consumable tuning/development only; no confirmation, blind, official, or fresh-generalization claim
development_screen.prior_usage_audit: No exact seed token was found in the current text/JSON/JSONL evidence under runs/, evaluations/, submissions/, or repository documentation. Historical pilot schedules are incomplete, so global non-use is not proven.
development_screen.comparison: frozen driver and option composite on identical (track_id, geometry_seed) cells
development_screen.primary_metric: integer finish count; per-cell paired changes
development_screen.selection_rule: Development feedback only. A nonzero candidate finish and no fewer finishes than the base are a pilot continuation signal, not confirmation or promotion. Do not tune repeatedly on a claim of independent evidence from these same cells.

iteration_boundary: At most one feedback-driven second training attempt may use this same consumed development screen. Any such result remains development evidence only; a later generalization claim needs a separately audited new protocol and cells.
prohibitions: Do not use any listed or other reserved blind cell.
Do not claim official HAIC score, model confirmation, or model promotion.
Do not modify core/, env_wrapper.py, damage.py, train.py, train_drqv2.py, drq_v2.py, agent.py, evaluate_policy.py, or package_submission.py in this pilot integration.
Do not run an unbounded training/evaluation loop.
